updateTime.description: Date and time when this consolidated CAMS ticket document was last updated by the consolidation engine

title.description: Title of the CAMS anomaly ticket

key.description: CAMS ticket key uniquely identifying the ticket

affected_systems.description: Systems affected by the anomaly reported in the ticket

criticality.description: Criticality level of the anomaly ticket

urgency.description: Urgency level of the anomaly ticket

entity.description: Entity responsible for or associated with the ticket

assigned_element.description: Ground segment element(s) or station(s) the ticket is assigned to

review_board_dispositions.description: Review board dispositions recorded for the ticket

updated.description: Last update date of the ticket

occurence_date.description: Date when the reported anomaly occurred

environment.description: Impacted environment(s) referenced by the ticket, used to link impacted entities

linked_issues.description: Keys of issues linked to this ticket

origin.description: Origin of the anomaly taken from the latest linked anomaly correlation file

description.description: Description of the anomaly taken from the latest linked anomaly correlation file

correlation_file_id.description: Identifiers of the linked anomaly correlation (AN) files associated with this ticket

url.description: URL to the ticket in the CAMS browse interface

datatake_ids.description: Datatake identifiers impacted by the ticket, aggregated from linked anomaly correlation files

acquisition_pass.description: Acquisition pass keys impacted by the ticket, aggregated from linked anomaly correlation files

products.description: Product names impacted by the ticket, aggregated from linked anomaly correlation files

publications.description: Publication names impacted by the ticket, aggregated from linked anomaly correlation files

esa_group.description: ESA group associated with the ticket
